reason: A context-retention guard for agent compaction that detects missing literal anchors in summaries and injects a one-shot recovery notice using the append-only session log.

summaries.zh: 在智能体压缩上下文后检查关键字面锚点是否丢失，并在下一步注入一次性恢复提示。
summaries.en: Detects missing literal anchors after agent context compaction and injects a one-time recovery notice into the next step.

capabilities: Extracts literal anchors from shadowed context
Compares anchors with the committed summary
Injects a one-shot recovery notice into a subsequent agent step
